title: Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) Statement on Policy Repo Rate
body: The Monetary Policy Committee of the Reserve Bank of India met on October 7 to 9, 2026. After a detailed assessment of the evolving macroeconomic dynamics, the MPC decided by a 5 to 1 majority to keep the policy repo rate under the liquidity adjustment facility (LAF) unchanged at 6.50 per cent. Consequently, the standing deposit facility (SDF) rate remains at 6.25 per cent and the marginal standing facility (MSF) rate and the Bank Rate at 6.75 per cent. The MPC also decided to maintain the monetary policy stance focused on withdrawal of accommodation to ensure that inflation progressively aligns to the target of 4.0 per cent while supporting economic growth.

title: SEBI Mandates Granular Disclosures of Beneficial Ownership by Foreign Portfolio Investors
body: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has released comprehensive operational guidelines regarding mandatory disclosures for Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs). Under the framework, FPIs holding more than 50 percent of their Indian equity Assets Under Management (AUM) in a single corporate group, or FPIs with overall equity AUM in Indian markets exceeding Rs 25,000 crore, must provide granular end-investor disclosures up to the natural person level. This regulatory measure aims to prevent circumvention of Minimum Public Shareholding (MPS) requirements and combat potential misuse of the FPI route for market manipulation.

title: WHO Updates Public Health Advice for Respiratory Pathogen Season
body: The World Health Organization (WHO) has issued seasonal clinical and epidemiological recommendations for preventing respiratory illnesses ahead of the winter season. WHO highlights that co-circulation of influenza viruses, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and SARS-CoV-2 strains requires proactive vigilance. Health authorities worldwide are encouraged to promote seasonal vaccination among high-risk demographics including elderly populations and healthcare workers, enhance indoor air exchange and ventilation, and maintain mask usage in high-density clinical settings.

title: NASA Confirms All Science Instruments Operational on Europa Clipper
body: Engineers and mission scientists at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory have completed the initial health checkout and deployment sequencing for the Europa Clipper spacecraft. Telemetry confirms that all payload science instruments, including the Radar for Europa Assessment and Sounding: Ocean to Near-surface (REASON), the Europa Clipper Magnetometer (ECM), and the Mapping Imaging Spectrometer for Europa (MISE), are functioning with nominal performance as the probe journeys toward the Jupiter system.

title: Cabinet Approves Enhanced Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme 2.0 for IT Hardware
body: The Union Cabinet chaired by the Prime Minister approved budgetary enhancements and operational flexibilities under the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme 2.0 for IT Hardware. The scheme covers laptops, tablets, all-in-one PCs, servers, and ultra-small form factor computers. Eligible domestic and global electronics manufacturers will receive an average financial incentive of approximately 5% on net incremental sales of manufactured goods over the base year, spurring localized semiconductor component sourcing and high-technology manufacturing employment.

title: Cloud Hyperscalers Double Down on Data Center CapEx Amid Generative AI Surge
body: Leading cloud infrastructure providers Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, and Google Cloud have recorded substantial expansions in capital expenditures throughout recent fiscal quarters. Executives across all three hyperscalers reaffirmed that the surge in capital allocation is directly channeled into cutting-edge AI accelerator clusters, high-bandwidth optical networking, and custom tensor-processing data center infrastructure to meet unprecedented enterprise demand for training and deploying large language models.

title: India Surpasses 200 GW Milestone in Total Non-Fossil Fuel Power Generation Capacity
body: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy announced that India has officially crossed 200 gigawatts (GW) of installed electricity capacity derived from non-fossil fuel energy sources, including solar photovoltaic, wind energy, large hydroelectric projects, and biomass power. This achievement underscores India's accelerated transition toward sustainable energy infrastructure, moving steadily toward the national goal of achieving 500 GW of non-fossil capacity well before the 2030 target deadline.

title: Benchmark Indices Nifty and Sensex Rally Following CPI Inflation Cooling
body: Indian benchmark equity indices Nifty 50 and S&P BSE Sensex registered robust gains during Friday's trading session following the release of favorable macroeconomic data. Retail inflation measured by the Consumer Price Index (CPI) moderated comfortably within the Reserve Bank of India's targeted 2 to 6 percent tolerance corridor. The positive print sparked broad-based buying across rate-sensitive banking, real estate, and automobile equities as market participants priced in prospective monetary easing in upcoming quarters.

title: TRAI Issues Stringent Directions to Telecom Service Providers on Anti-Spam Enforcements
body: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) issued strict directives to all Access Service Providers to immediately clamp down on unsolicited commercial communications (UCC) and fraudulent messaging. Under the new regulatory mandate, telecom carriers must disconnect all telecom resources allocated to unregistered telemarketers (UTMs) found initiating promotional voice calls and spam SMS. Additionally, operators must enforce end-to-end cryptographic whitelist verification of all web links, contact numbers, and application URLs embedded within commercial SMS templates.

title: Fact Check: Viral Claim Alleging RBI Demonetisation of 500 Rupee Notes is Completely False
body: A viral forwarded message circulating widely across social messaging platforms claims that the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has issued an official notification declaring all existing 500 rupee currency notes invalid as legal tender from next month. BOOM Live investigated the claim and contacted the Reserve Bank of India and PIB Fact Check. Both authorities confirmed that no such decision has been taken. The Reserve Bank of India has issued no circular regarding demonetisation of 500 rupee notes, and all currency notes currently in circulation remain legal tender.

title: SEBI Alerts General Public and Investors Against Deepfake Videos Promoting Trading Scams
body: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has published an urgent public warning concerning synthetic media and deepfake videos of SEBI officials and top market personalities. Fraudulent social media advertisements using manipulated audio and video clips have attempted to deceive retail investors into transferring funds into unauthorized trading algorithms with promises of assured astronomical returns. SEBI explicitly reiterated that its officials never recommend specific stocks or promise investment yields.
